payload.prompt: How does property lookup work in JavaScript? Explain the Prototype Chain.
payload.modelAnswer: When you access a property on an object, JS first checks the object itself. If not found, it follows the hidden __proto__ link to its prototype object, checking there. This traversal continues up the chain until it reaches Object.prototype, which has a __proto__ of null. If it's still not found, it returns undefined.
